I mainly use it for back pain relief and knee support, and it really works. I’ve also noticed gradual weight loss without intense gym workouts. Perfect for seniors and beginners!

reviews.title: Lost all my data after last updates!
reviews.text:
I’ve been using this app for over two years as a premium member, paying $39.99 per year. Until recently, everything worked great. Unfortunately, after the latest updates, all of my exercises and programs from the past two years have completely disappeared.

I’m currently trying to recover my data, but the app has removed the “stop my tracking” button, making the situation even more frustrating. On top of that, the AI chat now generates programs exclusively for women—even when I clearly specify my gender as male. No matter how many times I set my profile to male, the app seems to ignore it entirely.

The situation has gotten worse: all 3D step-by-step exercise demonstrations are gone. Instead, there are only pre-recorded videos of very basic exercises performed by women. Even when requesting a men’s workout program, I get videos of women explaining glute workouts to men. The original 3D programs and exercises that made this app unique have simply vanished.

This is extremely disappointing, especially after investing two years of consistent work and progress into the app. Losing all my completed programs and exercise history feels unacceptable for a paid premium service.

I hope the team fixes these serious issues soon. I’ll give it a couple of weeks, but if nothing changes, I’ll be forced to cancel my premium subscription and delete the app. It’s a real shame to see such a promising app decline like this!
